histology: ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC; per user framing, consistent with the supplied pathology narrative; the histology line of the path report was not quoted at intake)
stage: Recurrent PDAC. New pancreatic body mass (July 2026) with likely vascular invasion, roughly 4 months after completing adjuvant FOLFIRINOX (March 2026). Prior course: neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX x6 (2025), then R0 resection (December 2025) with 0/34 nodes and CAP tumor regression grade 2 (partial response: evident regression, but more than single cells or rare small groups of residual cancer). The recurrence is radiographic only so far; it has not been biopsied or re-sequenced.

biomarkers.name: CLDN18.2
biomarkers.value: positive, moderate-to-strong: 2+/3+ membranous staining in 60% of tumor cells (resected primary, December 2025 specimen)
biomarkers.method: IHC on the resection specimen; clone/assay not stated in the supplied report (the zolbetuximab companion diagnostic is the VENTANA CLAUDIN 18 (43-14A) assay)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: The expression call on the primary is at usable resolution. Two hardening steps remain: (1) the zolbetuximab registrational cutoff (SPOTLIGHT/GLOW, gastric/GEJ) is >=75% of tumor cells at 2+/3+ by the 43-14A CDx assay, so at 60% this case is CLDN18.2-positive but below that cutoff; if zolbetuximab or a threshold-gated trial is pursued, re-stain with the CDx assay. (2) CLDN18.2 has not been assessed on the recurrent lesion; CAR-T and ADC programs use their own, often lower, cutoffs and may require fresh tissue.

biomarkers.value: not assessed; the recurrence has not been biopsied. The 60% 2+/3+ result is from the resected primary only.

biomarkers.decision_resolution: IHC on recurrent-lesion tissue, ideally with the VENTANA CLAUDIN 18 (43-14A) CDx assay, or with the sponsor assay of whichever CLDN18.2 trial is under consideration. Needed wherever a therapy or trial gates on current tissue rather than archival primary.

biomarkers.decision_resolution: Low at decision resolution; together with MSS status this closes the TMB-high pembrolizumab route.

Guidelines recommend germline testing for every PDAC patient, and incidental tumor-NGS reporting does not rule these genes out. The result gates PARP-inhibitor and platinum-emphasis strategies.

targetable_features.feature: CLDN18.2 expression, moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) in 60% of tumor cells
targetable_features.rationale: The strongest handle in this case. The tumor is CLDN18.2-positive, but 60% sits below the >=75% (2+/3+) cutoff used in SPOTLIGHT/GLOW for zolbetuximab, and that approval covers gastric/GEJ, not PDAC, so zolbetuximab here would be off-label or trial-based on two counts. CLDN18.2 CAR-T (satri-cel and others), ADCs, and bispecifics use different, often lower, eligibility cutoffs, and several programs enroll PDAC. Hedges that must carry through: the stain is from the resected primary, not the recurrence; the assay and clone were not named; and a 60% result below the registrational cutoff is a weaker predictor of benefit than a >=75% result would be. A re-stain with the CDx assay, ideally on recurrent tissue, would raise confidence.

Y220C creates a druggable crevice in p53, and rezatapopt (PC14586) is a Y220C-selective reactivator with a solid-tumor registrational program (PYNNACLE), so the population fits this case. This is a trial-eligibility route, not an approved therapy. Confirming the variant persists in the recurrence, by ctDNA or biopsy, would firm it up.

The PDAC driver here. G12R is not addressed by G12C agents (sotorasib, adagrasib) or by G12D-selective agents; the live routes are pan-RAS(ON) inhibitors such as daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), which has PDAC-focused registrational work, plus mutant-KRAS vaccines that include G12R in their peptide pools (e.g. ELI-002) and cellular or TCR approaches. Investigational across the board in PDAC.

A frameshift in a COMPASS-complex histone methyltransferase. The weakest handle on the list: no approved or late-stage KMT2C-directed therapy exists, and the actionability hypotheses (epigenetic agents, synthetic-lethal pairings) are preclinical. Included because the user asked for every variant to stay on the table.

A decision-relevant negative, carried as a feature so downstream agents address it instead of silently dropping it. MSS plus TMB 0.83 mut/Mb closes the MSI-high and TMB-high checkpoint-blockade routes; any immunotherapy interest has to come from other mechanisms (vaccines, cellular therapy, combinations), not single-agent PD-1 blockade.

targetable_features.feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
targetable_features.rationale: R0 with 0/34 nodes and CAP tumor regression grade 2 after neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX, yet a new pancreatic body mass with likely vascular invasion appeared about 4 months after finishing adjuvant FOLFIRINOX. Recurrence this early despite favorable surgical pathology signals aggressive biology and functional FOLFIRINOX resistance. That argues for treating the recurrence as systemic disease, weighs against re-challenge with the same regimen, and is the prognostic context the ranking should sit in. Biopsy confirmation of the recurrence is still pending.
